claims.claim: The bounded capture_origin primitive accepts only host metadata's exact openai/session field and returns a provider-neutral opaque handle with fixed status metadata, without retaining or emitting the raw value.

Derivation uses an explicit versioned, provider-domain-separated SHA-256 contract. Focused tests assert repeat stability, distinct synthetic origins, exact-input preservation, and domain/version separation.
Invalid, absent, null, non-string, empty, and over-bound metadata produces no handle. Focused tests cover forbidden fallback sources, argument rejection, ambient-I/O guards, and duplicate JSON keys.

The dedicated stdio MCP entry advertises one read-only operation requiring no semantic arguments and forwards SDK request-context metadata to capture_origin. Offline tests cover forwarding, the actual stdio adapter, and absence of filesystem mutation.

Changes are limited to the six authorized files and introduce no routing database, browser automation, wake delivery, Work/MCP-Events dependency, transcript interpretation, or lifecycle and authority changes.

The conformance documentation records the OpenAI feasibility basis and bounded post-publication two-chat Human/Brain procedure, distinguishes TASK acceptance from live proof, disclaims session-to-URL equivalence, and keeps H4C1 blocked until H4C0 live closure.
